description: This file implements API endpoints for managing user profiles in a sports live stream platform. It includes operations to create, retrieve, update, search, and delete user profiles, utilizing FastAPI's routing and request handling, along with SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions. The code defines multiple endpoints with associated logic, including permission checks and data conversions.

methods.name: create_user_profile( profile_data: UserProfileCreate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None )
methods.description: Creates a new user profile with provided data, ensuring no duplicate exists, and assigns a generated profile ID.

methods.name: get_my_profile(request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's profile based on trusted user identification.

methods.name: update_my_profile( profile_update: UserProfileUpdate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None )
methods.description: Updates the current user's profile fields with provided data and refreshes the update timestamp.

methods.name: get_profile_by_id( profile_id: str, request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None )
methods.description: Fetches a user profile by profile ID, enforcing privacy restrictions for private profiles.

methods.name: search_profiles( q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search query for display name or username"), favorite_sport: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by favorite sport"), location: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by location"), verified_only: bool = Query(False, description="Show only verified profiles"), limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Number of profiles to return"), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of profiles to skip"), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = None )
methods.description: Searches for user profiles based on optional filters like query string, favorite sport, location, verification status. Includes visibility filtering based on authentication.
